findings.evidence: classSum_eq_sum (lines 39-40) already proves equality to that sum; `MonoidAlgebra.of` = `single _ 1` (mathlib Defs.lean:659); `C.carrier` is a Fintype via the imported ConjFinite instances (used in the `∑ x : C.carrier` at line 40).
findings.fix: Define `classSum C := ∑ x : C.carrier, MonoidAlgebra.of k G x`, reusing `Finset.sum` and `MonoidAlgebra.of`. Then classSum_eq_sum becomes `rfl` and the whole Nontrivial/ofCoeff scaffolding disappears.
findings.issue: classSum reconstructs `∑ x : C.carrier, MonoidAlgebra.of k G x` (exactly classSum_eq_sum's RHS) from a raw `ofCoeff`/Finsupp record plus a spurious `by_cases Nontrivial k` split (needed only because the manual `mem_support_toFun` fails when `1 = 0`).

findings.evidence: grep of TauCeti finds no reference to `classSumOfDecidableEq` outside its definition; both records build `toFun := fun x => if ConjClasses.mk x = C then 1 else 0`.
findings.fix: Remove it; once classSum is the Finset.sum above it is already computable/uniform and no second definition is warranted (no consumers exist in the diff or elsewhere in TauCeti).
findings.issue: classSumOfDecidableEq is a parallel, unused API defining the same element as classSum via the same Finsupp record, only with a DecidableEq k side condition.

findings.fix: Delete it and use `Finsupp.finsetSum_apply` (or `Finset.sum_apply'`); the proof already calls `MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum` immediately before, which covers the same need.
findings.issue: The local `sum_apply` helper re-proves by induction that pointwise evaluation commutes with a finite sum of Finsupps.

summary: The class-sum concept is new (no Mathlib/TauCeti replacement), but classSum is hand-rolled from raw Finsupp pieces instead of the sum it is proven equal to, and it ships a redundant parallel API plus a re-derived library lemma.
